topic: Geometric Intuition in Linear Algebra: Seeing Space Dance
target_audience: Undergraduate students and advanced high school students

sections.title: Vectors as Movements, Not Just Numbers
lecture_lines: Meet Pixie, our guide in this digital grid world.
Vectors are arrows showing movement, not just static numbers.
Vector [3, 2] means moving 3 right and 2 up.
animations: [Animation 1] Draw black background with white grid. Draw white arrow from (0,0) to (3,2) in #00FFFF. Change color of line 1 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 2] Display text "[3, 2]" in #FFFF00 near vector tip. Draw dashed lines to axes. Change color of line 2 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 3] Animate small circle (#FF00FF) moving along the x-axis then y-axis to (3,2). Change color of line 3 to #FFFF00.

sections.title: The Foundation: Basis Vectors
lecture_lines: Standard basis vectors i-hat and j-hat define our grid.
i-hat is one step right; j-hat is one step up.
Every vector is a combination of these basic hops.
animations: [Animation 1] Highlight unit vector i-hat (0,0) to (1,0) in #FF0000 and j-hat to (0,1) in #00FF00. Change color of line 1 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 2] Add labels "\hat{i}" (#FF0000) and "\hat{j}" (#00FF00) next to the vectors. Change color of line 2 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 3] Show three copies of i-hat (#FF0000) and two of j-hat (#00FF00) reaching (3,2). Change color of line 3 to #FFFF00.

sections.title: Matrices as Space Transformers
lecture_lines: Matrices don't just multiply; they transform the entire space.
The origin stays fixed while the world reshapes around.
Watch the grid tilt during this "shear" transformation.
Grid lines remain parallel and evenly spaced throughout.
Linear transformations keep the grid's underlying structure consistent.
animations: [Animation 1] Show standard grid [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg]. Display matrix [[1, 1], [0, 1]] in #FFFFFF. Change color of line 1 to #FFFF00.

[Animation 3] Transform grid: tilt vertical lines 45 degrees. Change color of line 3 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 4] Highlight two parallel grid lines in #00FFFF. Change color of line 4 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 5] Briefly flash several grid squares in #FF00FF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] to show consistency. Change color of line 5 to #FFFF00.

sections.title: The 'Where Do They Land?' Rule
lecture_lines: Where do the basis vectors land after the transformation?
The first column tells us exactly where i-hat goes.
The second column shows the new home of j-hat.
Knowing these two destinations determines the entire transformation.
See how rotation moves i-hat and j-hat to new spots.
animations: [Animation 1] Display matrix [[0, -1], [1, 0]] in #FFFFFF. Show initial i-hat (#FF0000) and j-hat (#00FF00). Change color of line 1 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 2] Draw box around first column [0, 1] in #FF0000. Change color of line 2 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 3] Draw box around second column [-1, 0] in #00FF00. Change color of line 3 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 4] Animate i-hat moving to (0,1) and j-hat moving to (-1,0) simultaneously. Change color of line 4 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 5] Transition the rest of the grid lines to match the new basis. Change color of line 5 to #FFFF00.

sections.title: The Determinant: Scaling the Area
lecture_lines: The determinant measures how space is scaled or squished.
It's the area of the transformed unit square.
A determinant of four means the area quadruples.
A determinant of zero squishes the world into one dimension.
Pixie's two-dimensional world loses all its area.
animations: [Animation 1] Draw unit square (0,0) to (1,1) filled with #FFFF00 at 0.3 opacity. Change color of line 1 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 2] Add label "Area = 1" in #FFFFFF inside the square. Change color of line 2 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 3] Apply scaling (matrix [[2, 0], [0, 2]]), square grows to 4x area. Change color of line 3 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 4] Change label to "Area = 4" in #FFFFFF. Change color of line 4 to #FFFF00.
[Animation 5] Apply matrix [[1, 1], [1, 1]] to collapse square to line; label "Area = 0". Change color of line 5 to #FFFF00.

sections.title: Summary: Thinking with Eyes
lecture_lines: Vectors are movements that define our starting points.
Matrices transform space by moving the basis vectors.
Determinants track how the total area changes.

[Animation 3] Morph matrix symbols into the transformed grid lines using ReplacementTransform. Change color of line 3 to #FFFF00.
